hook_line: DOW FALLS 739 POINTS IN NVIDIA-LED AI SELL-OFF

hook_stat.sub: Points the Dow fell on Monday, a 1.4% drop to 51,608.17

stats.label: Nvidia's drop to $156.14, its lowest close since July 1, 2025
Nvidia market value lost since the scandal around Huang erupted
Surge in the VIX, Wall Street's fear gauge

diaspora_bullets: The sell-off spread beyond Nvidia: Broadcom fell 3.9%, AMD 5.6% and Intel 7.1%
S&P 500 earnings are tracking nearly 32% higher than a year earlier, FactSet figures show
news_summary: US stocks closed sharply lower on Monday as Nvidia fell for a third straight day after Jensen Huang's resignation, the Dow dropped 739 points, and a new US rule restricting China's remote access to advanced chips added pressure on AI stocks.
payoff: Nvidia's Tuesday earnings, its first since Huang's exit, will be read as a verdict on the AI trade itself.
